registration: Locally frozen before the first Codex suite execution; not an external preregistration or an independent replication.
scope: P0 paragraph loci only. Common locus IDs shared by both transcriptions. Missing loci are excluded from both, not imputed.
split: Group by folio number, keeping recto, verso and panels together; f85 and f86 are conservatively grouped together. FNV-1a of group + |codex-split-v1 modulo 5 equals 0 for heldout. This is a frozen internal validation split, not evidence of statistical independence between folios.
strict: Strip IVTFF comments and paragraph markers. Treat illustration interruptions as run boundaries. Split on certain dots only. Retain lowercase a-z tokens only. Reject entire candidates containing uncertainty, commas, alternative readings, ligatures, uppercase letters or rare-glyph codes. Rejected tokens break adjacency runs.
first-reading: Sensitivity projection only: select first bracketed reading; flatten brace ligatures; lowercase; treat uncertain commas as spaces. Reject all remaining non-a-z candidates. It is not a corrected transcription or evidence that the selected reading is true.

tests.name: Adjacent-token repetition
tests.statistic: Fraction of within-line, within-run adjacent token pairs that are identical.
tests.null: Token order is exchangeable within each folio page/panel, retaining that page's token multiset and all retained run lengths.
tests.alternative: Observed adjacent-token repetition is greater than this constrained shuffle null.

tests.name: Within-token conditional entropy
tests.statistic: Empirical H(next EVA character | current EVA character), in bits, over internal token bigrams. No cross-token pairs.
tests.null: Character order is exchangeable independently inside each retained token, retaining every token's length and character multiset.
tests.alternative: Observed within-token conditional entropy is lower than this constrained shuffle null.

statistics: One-sided Monte Carlo p=(extreme+1)/(499+1), inclusive ties. Effect=observed minus null mean. Null 2.5/97.5 percentiles are descriptive shuffle ranges, not confidence intervals. Holm adjustment covers all 16 source × policy × partition × hypothesis comparisons. Family alpha=0.05. Round published numerics to 10 decimal places.
rng: xorshift32, unsigned output divided by 2^32, Fisher-Yates shuffle. Each comparison starts with seed XOR FNV-1a(source|policy|partition|test). Zero state becomes 1.
limits: EVA characters are transcription conventions, not established original glyph units or phonemes.
Strict exclusion is not random and may introduce selection bias; the first-reading projection measures one sensitivity, not all uncertainty.
ZL and IT are not independent manuscripts and share editorial history. Agreement is transcription robustness, not independent confirmation.
Rejection of these narrow exchangeability nulls does not establish language, encryption, meaning, authorship or decipherment.
No natural-language baseline, cipher emulator, decoding procedure or singulion-study replication is included.
Heldout results are displayed once the fixed suite runs; they must not be reused as an untouched test set for future tuned hypotheses.
